$description: Quiet content surface. Noninteractive by default; a card is not automatically a button or link.
name: Card

behavior.interaction: Informational card container is noninteractive; expose explicit button/link actions within it.
behavior.border: Outlined is the default, plain omits its border. No elevation by default.
behavior.layout: Natural height; in equal-height grids the card surface may stretch to fill its row.

accessibility: Use semantic article/section containers where appropriate; do not add role=button to a noninteractive card.
Headings follow a meaningful document hierarchy.
Never make the entire card clickable in addition to nested interactive controls.

web: Use semantic HTML controls, keyboard focus-visible, and 24×24 CSS px minimum targets; prefer more space for touch.
Retain browser zoom and allow labels to wrap or controls to grow.
Use <article> or <section> for meaningful grouped content.
ios: Respect 44pt minimum interactive hit area and Dynamic Type; prefer native Button/Control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility label/state APIs.
android: Respect 48dp minimum interactive target and nonlinear font scaling; prefer native Compose/View control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility semantics.
